setup_batch_predict_server: deploy a Ray Serve BatchPredictServer with an MLIPPredictUnit for batched molecular inference with configurable replicas and GPU allocation
BatchPredictServer_predict: process a batch of AtomicData objects through the MLIP model with automatic OOM batch splitting and retry logic
BatchPredictServer_configure_batching: configure the maximum batch size and wait timeout for the Ray Serve batched prediction deployment
BatchPredictServer_split_predictions: split batched prediction tensors back into per-system and per-atom prediction dictionaries after inference
BatchPredictServer_get_predict_unit_attr: retrieve an attribute from the underlying MLIPPredictUnit instance by its name at runtime
